title: Watchtower passdown — dawn
content:
Watchtower passdown (dawn)
03/12 07:00 -> 03/13 07:00
owner: Maya Patel (dawn)
notes-status: draft — quick handoff sketch for next oncall

1) TL;DR
- No sev active. Two recurring alerts suppressed: `svc-embed-p99-latency` and `redis-kv-thrash`.
- Temporary mitigations applied; both need root-cause follow-up (see tickets).
- Primary action for next: monitor embed p99 for 30m after traffic spike window (08:00-09:30 PT).

2) Active/Recent signals
- svc-embed-p99-latency: p99 spikes to ~1.4s during short traffic bursts (last seen 03/12 08:23). Auto-fallback to quantized-variant engaged at 3x threshold.
  - Current mitigation: fallback policy is enabled (route->model-quant-q8-mild) for affected route /v1/embeddings/chat.
  - Temporary crawlback: rollback routing window to 200rps for 10m if p99 > 1s.
- redis-kv-thrash (01:00–02:20): connection churn on cache nodes after nightly job. Throttled job and flushed smallest LRU cache. No data loss; elevated miss rate persists ~3%.

3) Immediate actions for incoming shift
- Watch: `svc-embed-p99-latency` metric + alert on Datadog dashboard (Dashboard: SRE/serving/embed)
- If p99 > 1s for 5m straight: manually increase fallback window to 30m and notify Solutions-CE to expect degraded embed vectors.
- If redis missrate > 5% for > 10m: run `kubectl -n cache rollout restart statefulset/redis-cache` on cluster-prod-1; coordinate with infra slack (#infra-ops) before restart.

4) Quick commands (copy/paste) — use with care
- Check p99: `ddog query "avg:trace.embed.p99{env:prod} by {route}" --from=now-30m`
- Trigger manual fallback: `redwoodctl route update --route /v1/embeddings/chat --fallback model:meta/quant-q8-mild --duration 30m`
- Restart redis statefulset: `kubectl -n cache rollout restart statefulset/redis-cache --context prod-cluster-1`
- View last 200 serving logs (service: embed-service): `kubectl -n serving logs deploy/embed-service -c exporter --tail=200`

5) Known flaky spots / hypotheses
- Hypothesis A: embedding model kernel selection backoff on certain batch-size distributions (spike correlated with sudden small-batch churn). Fix: adjust batch timeout heuristics for the route.
- Hypothesis B: nightly cleanup job touches cache keys with prefix `session:` causing eviction storms. Temporarily changed job to stagger keys; permanent fix needs job rewrite.

6) Tickets / follow-ups
- OPS-789: investigate embed p99 spikes/route-level batching (owner: Owen Chen) — waiting for perf trace from 03/12 08:23 (trace id: trace-03-12-0823). Next: attach trace to ticket + add perf board notes.
- INF-321: rewrite nightly cleanup to use cursor-based deletes and add jitter (owner: Lina Morales). PR in progress -> test in staging.
- CS-1444: customer TSE noticed degraded similarity scores when fallback engaged. Pinged Solutions; need customer-facing note if fallback repeated.

7) Escalation quick list
- First: oncall SRE slack @sre-oncall (primary pager) — use channel `#sre-watchtower`.
- Pager escalation: PagerDuty -> Escalate to SRE lead: "Marco Silva" (pager: +1-415-555-0123) if incident meets sev2 criteria.
- Infra contact (k8s, cluster ops): Lina Morales (slack/lina.m@redwood.ai)
- Model ops / embeddings SME: Owen Chen (slack/owner.owen)

8) Temporary runbook snippet (for embed p99)
- Detection: p99 > 1s sustained > 5m.
- Immediate: enable route fallback for 30m, lower route concurrency to 4.
  - `redwoodctl route update --route /v1/embeddings/chat --concurrency 4 --fallback model:meta/quant-q8-mild --duration 30m`
- Notify: post to `#sre-watchtower` with current graph screenshot and trace id.
- Postmortem: file short incident note in confluence under Playbooks -> Embedding Degrads.

9) Notes to self (rough)
- Remember to add a dashboard widget showing fallback rate by model variant.
- Check whether the autoscaler respects the quantized-variant GPU overhead (suspect it doesn't, causing underprovisioning during fallback).
- Chat with product about TTL on session keys; long TTLs worsen eviction storms.

10) Questions / open decisions
- Should fallback be global or route-scoped for this customer cohort? (ops vs solutions tradeoff)
- How aggressive should autoscaling be for quantized models (cost vs latency)?

11) Misc quick logs / evidence
- Last significant trace: trace-03-12-0823 — embed p99 spike; related logs show repeated small-batch 1–3 requests coalesced incorrectly.
- Redis eviction pattern: 03/12 01:06–01:22 — eviction spikes aligned with cleanup windows.

12) Hand-off checklist for next person
- [ ] Confirm fallback toggles returned to baseline after 30m
- [ ] Re-check redis missrate and if still >1% open follow-up INF-321
- [ ] Attach any new traces to OPS-789
- [ ] Leave a short passdown message in `#sre-watchtower` thread

End of passdown. Loose notes; add to ticket or convert to a formal runbook when stable. If you pick this up, ping me on slack (@maya.p) with questions.
